items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Well thanks, Monk. I’ve watched your interviews with a number of folks... I really enjoy being a part of this.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. I’m very pleased to have John LaBarbera with me today. I’m going to introduce you as first a fourth trumpeter, composer/arranger, and I’m very glad to have you here because I love talking about composing and arranging.
Well thanks, Monk. I’ve watched your interviews with a number of folks, including my brother Pat, and you know, I really enjoy being a part of this. Really.

Excellent. I’m not going to spend a lot of time on this but I had a couple of thoughts and questions about the family band. For those of you who might be watching we have three brothers and your father and mother were also in the group. Is that correct?
